hash_policy.github_blob_sha1: Exact GitHub Git blob object ID from the upstream repository at the recorded commit. Verify with git hash-object on an identical checked-in snapshot.
hash_policy.sha256: The repository verifier computes SHA-256 locally for audit output. It is not claimed as a provider-supplied signature.
hash_policy.source_commit_pin: A Git commit pin identifies the reviewed upstream source generation; a pin is not an on-chain deployment attestation.
